events.name: Bash
events.head: Recheck the app-fix PR state and scan cards and playbook for add-on wording
events.input: $ gh pr view 196 -R Usetantra/tantra-frontend-v2 --json state,reviewRequests,title 2>&1 | head -5; grep -rnIiE '\$10 ?/ ?mo|\$10/month add|Not in your plan|Add-on required' app/src cloud/src workshop-plan/playbook 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -20; echo "grep-exit-done"
